name: TenantMaintenanceRequestPortal
tagline: Resident repair requests with emergency triage, photos, permission to enter and live status tracking.
description: A five-step resident repair wizard (unit and room, category with safety check and emergency escalation, photos, access windows and pets, review with priority and response target) plus a tracking view with KPIs, search and filters, progress tracker, timeline, messages, cancel/reopen and satisfaction rating. Runs in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Emergency safety check, guidance and tap-to-call escalation
Automatic Emergency / Urgent / Routine priority with response targets
Permission to enter, availability grid, pets and access notes
Tracking KPIs, search, filters and sort
Progress tracker, timeline and resident–helpdesk messages
Cancel, reopen and 1–5 star satisfaction rating
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and ARIA
Configurable labels, colours, categories and SLAs
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
